title: Band-9 Samples: Who do you spend most time talking to on the telephone? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 9 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 3 question: “Who do you spend most time talking to on the telephone? [Why?]” Sample 1 Female Male In my case, it’s my mother who I find myself talking to the most. She lives in a different city, so we make a point to catch up over the phone regularly. It helps us stay connected and updated about each other’s lives. Sample 2 Female Male My go-to person for phone conversations is my best friend from high school. Our talks are a mishmash of reminiscing about old times, sharing the latest news, and discussing our future plans. Sample 3 Female Male The person I spend the most time on the phone with is a fellow hobbyist. We share a common interest in astronomy and often spend hours discussing the latest celestial events. Sample 4 Female Male In my case, it’s my business partners that I find myself conversing with the most over the phone. You see, due to my entrepreneurial responsibilities, I often have limited leisure time. So, engaging in phone discussions with my colleagues helps streamline our operations and optimize productivity. Sample 5 Female Male Being a private tutor, I spend a significant amount of my phone time giving telephone lessons to my students. This method of instruction has proven quite effective, especially in the current digital age where learning has transcended the traditional classroom boundaries. Sample 6 Female Male As a sales representative, my phone seems to be perpetually attached to my ear. Most of the time, I’m engaged in negotiations with potential clients or following up on leads. This has not only become a crucial part of my job but also a routine part of my life. Sample 7: It Depends Female Male On action-packed workdays, my peers at work are the ones I usually exchange words with over the phone. This is primarily due to the collaborative nature of our work. But, on my restful days off, my friends are my go-to telephone companions, as these conversations offer a delightful diversion from work. Sample 8: It Depends Female Male During regular school days, I frequently converse with my classmates on the phone, particularly when we’re working on group projects. However, during festive periods, I tend to connect more with my extended family, sharing greetings and catching up on life’s happenings. Sample 9: Not Sure Female Male I must admit, I can’t really pinpoint who I spend the most time talking to on my mobile. The person at the other end of the line can change frequently, depending on the day’s events or my current needs. So, I can’t say there’s a single person who dominates my phone time. Sample 10: Not Sure Female Male To be honest, I’m not entirely sure who I spend most of my time chatting with on the telephone. My call log seems to vary from day to day. One day it could be my best friend, the next day it could be my manager. I suppose it depends on what’s happening in my life at the moment.
